scope: The main Château de Cheverny in its circa 2010 appearance. Includes the limestone front and rear walls, five roof masses, two large square pavilions and attached front stairs. The separate commons, kennel, gardens, and interiors are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: The original south elevation shows the broad pale facade, projecting square pavilions and curved slate roofs, two lanterns, central pavilion, steps, dormers, high chimneys and rhythmic fenestration.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla checked first. The original photograph by AndrewHorne carries the creator’s named English Wikipedia public-domain grant and upload history preserved by Commons. The rose photograph, previous château drawing and Blois photograph are outside this reconstruction. Supplemental modern rear views did not have public-domain grants, so the rear is estimated from the mapped building and exterior rhythm.
